query:
SELECT 
  SUM(JSON_LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT(briefData, '$.urgencySignals'))) as total_signals,
  COUNT(*) as companies_with_signals,
  ROUND(AVG(JSON_LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT(briefData, '$.urgencySignals'))), 1) as avg_signals_per_company
FROM companies 
WHERE searchId IN (1500002, 1500003) 
  AND briefData IS NOT NULL 
  AND JSON_EXTRACT(briefData, '$.urgencySignals') IS NOT NULL;
